# overwrites this file. Change the generator instead.
#
# Load order: The Great Revision -> ... -> Victorian Century -> THIS.
# Why this file exists: TGR adds 13 law groups and 60 laws; not one of VC's 56 new ideologies had an
#   opinion on any of them, so every interest group led by VC flavour was neutral
#   on TGR's entire political layer. Hand-authored, see the workbook beside this file.
#
# !! MAINTENANCE !! Bodies are a three-way merge with vanilla 1.13.11 as the
# common ancestor. After either mod updates, re-run the generator and read the
# conflict list it prints -- a new conflict means the authors started fighting
# over a line they used to leave alone.
